say: Finish these five checks before you use any AI tool for real work.
Download only from the Google Play Store or Apple App Store, from the real developer. Fake AI apps are a common way to steal data and money.
Use a long, unique password and turn on two-step verification.
In settings, switch off training on your chats where the tool allows it. In ChatGPT, that is under Data Controls. Use Temporary Chat for sensitive work.
And never paste ID, bank or client data.

panel.heading: Safe setup checklist
items: Official app or website only
Long unique password, two-step on
Training on your chats switched off
Temporary chat for sensitive work
No ID, bank or client data

say: Never paste BVN, NIN, bank or card numbers, passwords or one-time codes. Never paste other people's phone numbers, addresses or health details without permission.
Under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023, you are responsible for other people's personal data.

panel.heading: Never paste, safe to paste
left: BVN, NIN, bank or card numbers

say: For example, Blessing runs a savings group in Ibadan. Before asking for help with a complaint, she changes the member's name to Member A and deletes the phone number and address.
She keeps the 45,000 naira amount because it matters, then adds the real name back in WhatsApp herself.

say: Vague prompts give generic answers. Give the AI what you would give a new assistant on her first day. First, a role, like an experienced adult literacy trainer.

panel.heading: Five parts of a clear prompt
items: Role: who should the AI act as?
Task: what exactly should it produce?
Context: who is it for?
Format: what shape should it take?
Limits: what must it avoid or include?

say: Second, the task. For example, a one-page handout on reading a bank statement.

say: Tell the AI to write NOT STATED when information is missing. Then it is far less likely to guess.
If three rounds of follow-ups do not fix a draft, write that part yourself.

say: For facts, use SIFT, a method developed by Mike Caulfield. Stop. Notice a specific claim, like a fee or a date, and do not share it yet.

panel.heading: SIFT: four moves for any claim
items: Stop: do not share the claim yet
Investigate the source: open the link
Find better coverage: search it yourself
Trace to the original source

say: Investigate the source. If the AI gave a link, open it. Is it a real, official site?

say: For example, Ifeoma asked a chatbot for her profit margin. It said her profit was 270,000 naira, a margin of 60%.
She redoes it on her phone calculator. 40 gowns at 18,000 naira is 720,000 naira.
Take away 450,000 naira for materials and labour, and the profit is 270,000 naira. The AI was right there.
But margin is profit divided by revenue. That gives 37.5%, not 60%. The AI divided by costs instead.
Had she trusted it, she might have cut her prices too far.
To remember. Set up your tool safely, and never paste ID, bank or other people's data.
Prompt with the five parts. Check facts with SIFT and redo sums yourself.
AI can repeat human bias, so never let it alone rank or reject people.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Set up safely: two-step on, training off
Never paste ID, bank or other people's data
Prompt with role, task, context, format, limits
SIFT every fact, redo every sum
AI can repeat bias; never let it judge people
